description: Oldest-prefix reasoning removal on prefix-bound models (Fable 5.1, Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5.5), shared by the OpenCode TypeScript lane, the Pi lane and the Rust module. Anthropic's preserved-thinking table: "Remove `thinking` blocks from the start of the history, from the end, or all of them" is valid; "Remove a `thinking` block from the middle of the history and keep later ones" is invalid for every later thinking block. A session is one user message (tag 1) followed by `steps` assistant steps a0..a{steps-1}; step i carries signed thinking and visible content and owns tag i + 2, except the `untagged` steps, which own no tag. `already_removed` lists steps whose reasoning earlier passes already took off the wire. `removed_after` is every step whose reasoning is off the wire after the pass: the earlier removals plus the new ones.

cases.name: a contiguous oldest prefix up to the age cutoff
the walk stops at the first step it may not remove
steps already removed are passed over, never restored
the newest assistant is never removed
